home.title: Stroke explained: an animated, cited guide to stroke
home.description: Stroke in animations: blocked or burst arteries, core and penumbra, BE-FAST, NIHSS, thrombolysis, thrombectomy, prevention and recovery. Every claim cited.

what.title: What is a stroke? Ischaemic and haemorrhagic stroke explained
what.description: Blocked or burst: an animated guide to ischaemic and haemorrhagic stroke, how common stroke is, lifetime risk, survival, disability and recurrence.

vessels.title: Brain blood supply: circle of Willis, arterial territories, syndromes
vessels.description: Click an artery to see its territory and deficits: ACA, MCA, PCA, basilar and lacunar syndromes, the circle of Willis, collaterals and how often it varies.

cascade.title: Core and penumbra: time is brain, CBF thresholds, ischaemic cascade
cascade.description: Scrub the ischaemic core and penumbra against the clock: 1.9 million neurons a minute, blood-flow thresholds, collaterals, the cascade and reperfusion.

causes.title: Causes of ischaemic stroke: TOAST, AF, ESUS, stroke in the young
causes.description: Follow a clot from the heart, a carotid plaque or a small vessel. TOAST subtype shares, ESUS, AF monitoring trials, dissection, PFO and rare causes.

bleeds.title: Bleeding strokes: ICH, subarachnoid haemorrhage, Ottawa rule, CAA
bleeds.description: How intracerebral and subarachnoid haemorrhage unfold, animated: haematoma growth, thunderclap headache, the Ottawa rule, 6-hour CT and Boston criteria.

tia.title: TIA (mini stroke): definition, ABCD2 score and early stroke risk
tia.description: How a TIA is defined by tissue, not time. An ABCD2 teaching calculator and its limits, stroke risk over 2, 7 and 90 days, EXPRESS, SOS-TIA and mimics.

signs.title: Recognising stroke: FAST, BE-FAST, mimics and missed strokes
signs.description: Animated BE-FAST signs, a sensitivity and specificity explorer for stroke scales, mimics, chameleons, missed strokes and mobile stroke units. Cited.

imaging.title: Stroke imaging: CT, ASPECTS, CTA, perfusion and door-to-needle
imaging.description: Scrub the stroke pathway from door to needle or groin, score ASPECTS, test core and penumbra against DAWN and DEFUSE 3, and see DWI-FLAIR mismatch.

nihss.title: NIH Stroke Scale calculator and modified Rankin Scale explained
nihss.description: Try every NIHSS item with teaching notes, see the total and severity bands, the left hemisphere and posterior biases, and the mRS. A teaching tool. Cited.

lysis.title: Thrombolysis for stroke: alteplase vs tenecteplase, animated
lysis.description: How clot-dissolving drugs work, what delay does to benefit, bleeding risk, tenecteplase trials and late-window evidence, animated and cited.

evt.title: Thrombectomy for stroke: stent retriever, HERMES, late-window trials
evt.description: Watch a stent retriever remove a clot, then explore HERMES, DAWN, DEFUSE 3, large-core, basilar and medium-vessel trials and the cost of delay.

ich.title: Treating intracerebral haemorrhage: ICH score, BP, reversal, surgery
ich.description: ICH care, animated: the ICH score as a teaching calculator, blood pressure trials, reversal, the INTERACT3 bundle, surgery trials and restarting.

sah.title: Subarachnoid haemorrhage care: day 0 to 21, coil or clip, nimodipine
sah.description: Scrub day 0 to 21 after subarachnoid haemorrhage: rebleeding, hydrocephalus, DCI on days 4 to 14. Coil versus clip, ISAT, nimodipine, long-term issues.

unit.title: Stroke unit care: FeSS, complications and craniectomy explained
unit.description: Why stroke units save lives, first-week complications, the QASC FeSS bundle, malignant MCA infarct and craniectomy, and AVERT early mobilisation. Cited.

prevent.title: Stroke prevention: INTERSTROKE, blood pressure, statins, smoking
prevent.description: Which risk factors drive stroke? Explore INTERSTROKE, blood pressure and lipid trials, diabetes, smoking, diet and salt substitutes, with citations.

af.title: AF and stroke: CHA2DS2-VASc, DOAC timing, dual antiplatelets, LAAO
af.description: How atrial fibrillation causes stroke, a CHA2DS2-VASc teaching tool, DOACs and their timing, the dual antiplatelet window and appendage closure trials.

carotid.title: Carotid stenosis and PFO: NASCET, surgery, CREST-2, RoPE, PASCAL
carotid.description: Measure carotid stenosis the NASCET way, see surgery benefit by stenosis and timing, asymptomatic trials and CREST-2, and PFO closure with RoPE and PASCAL.

rehab.title: Stroke rehabilitation & recovery: the curve, arm, walking, aphasia
rehab.description: How recovery unfolds after stroke: the Copenhagen curve, plasticity, the proportional recovery debate, arm, walking, aphasia and the 2026 guideline.

after.title: Life after stroke: fatigue, mood, cognition, work and driving
after.description: The invisible effects of stroke over time, plus work, driving rules, sex and relationships, carers, younger people, pregnancy and long-term needs. Cited.

nursing.title: Stroke nursing care: the first 72 hours, swallow screen, neuro obs
nursing.description: Stroke nursing: the first 72 hours, swallow screen first, post-thrombolysis observations, GCS and NIHSS, bladder, skin, falls and aphasia. Cited.

frontier.title: Stroke research frontier: factor XI, neuroprotection, VNS, ICH
frontier.description: Stroke research with evidence labels: factor XI inhibitors, OCEANIC-STROKE, nerinetide, remote conditioning, vagus nerve stimulation, cell therapy, FASTEST.

history.title: History of stroke: from apoplexy to thrombectomy and beyond
history.description: A scrubbable timeline of stroke: apoplexy, Wepfer, Willis, Virchow, Moniz, CT, the penumbra, t-PA, the 2015 thrombectomy wave and the 2026 guidelines.

review.title: Stroke flashcards and mnemonics: 109 cited cards, BE-FAST, ABCD2
review.description: Flip-card review of stroke: vessels, TIA, NIHSS, alteplase, thrombectomy, ICH, SAH, prevention and rehabilitation, each cited, with an animated ABCD2.

quiz.title: Stroke quiz: 100 questions with cited explanations
quiz.description: Test yourself on stroke: territories, TIA, imaging, NIHSS, thrombolysis, thrombectomy, bleeds, stroke units, prevention and rehabilitation, with sources.

glossary.title: Stroke glossary: penumbra, ASPECTS, NIHSS, tenecteplase and more
glossary.description: Searchable stroke glossary: circle of Willis, penumbra, ASPECTS, NIHSS, mRS, mTICI, FeSS, CHA2DS2-VASc, PFO and aphasia, each cited, linked to its module.

sources.title: Stroke sources: every cited reference, searchable
sources.description: All references behind the Stroke Companion: trials, meta-analyses, reviews, AHA/ASA, ESO and NICE guidance and US drug labels, with PubMed and DOI links.
